Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made a critical factual error in the "EDUCATED GUESSES" section by incorrectly identifying "Metamorphosis" as a hallmark ability of Demon Hunters. In World of Warcraft, Metamorphosis is a signature ability of the Druid class (specifically the Feral specialization), not the Demon Hunter. This error led the Orchestrator to exclude the Druid from the initial class list and incorrectly include the Demon Hunter, which subsequently caused the group composition to fail the "bear" constraint (since Demon Hunters cannot transform into bears). This mistake propagated through the rest of the conversation, resulting in the final incorrect answer.
